response.sql: WITH region_stats AS (SELECT d.A3 as region, AVG(CAST(t.amount AS FLOAT)) as avg_amount, COUNT(t.trans_id) as transaction_count FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(CAST(t.amount AS FLOAT)) as cross_region_avg FROM trans t), above_avg_regions AS (SELECT rs.avg_amount, rs.transaction_count, (rs.avg_amount - oa.cross_region_avg) as difference FROM region_stats rs CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE rs.avg_amount > oa.cross_region_avg) SELECT AVG(avg_amount) as avg_transaction_amount, AVG(transaction_count) as avg_transaction_count, AVG(difference) as avg_difference FROM above_avg_regions;
